sdkRule: The currently pinned SDK may be acquired only before its official expiry (2026-10-18T09:48:20Z); build duration is not coupled to expiry. Any later existing artifact requires official metadata, unexpired acquisition, HTTP-error/600-second guards and full ZIP/TAR/tree/version verification before considering a transport-pin update. No expired retrieval bypass.

claims: All GitHub-hosted jobs, including larger runners, have a six-hour execution limit.
Self-hosted jobs have a five-day execution limit.
Standard public macos-15-intel provides Intel four CPU / 14 GB RAM and a fresh VM.
macos-15-large is Intel twelve CPU / 30 GB RAM; larger runner billing/organization access must be configured.
